Two suspected Jaish-e-Mohammed operatives arrested in West Bengal

West Bengal's Special Task Force (STF) arrested two suspected operatives of the terror outfit Jaish-e-Mohammed in Burdwan. Police stated that the operatives were allegedly gathering information on the movements of Suvendu Adhikari, a political figure, in Bardhaman last year. One report also suggested a suspected plot to track the movements of the Chief Minister.
